_about: Public-domain Charles Leslie (1650-1722), Irish nonjuror and controversialist against deists, Quakers, Socinians and Jews, for the Word Hoard: his Theological Works (London, 1721, two folio volumes), from Internet Archive scans of the eighteenth-century collection. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

leslie-works-1721-1: The theological works of the Reverend Mr. Charles Leslie, in two volumes, vol. 1 (London: W. Bowyer, 1721)
leslie-works-1721-2: The theological works of the Reverend Mr. Charles Leslie, in two volumes, vol. 2 (London: W. Bowyer, 1721)

_alternates.leslie-copies: The Oxford 1832 Theological Works in seven volumes (only vols. 1, 2, 3 and 7 are on the Archive, so the complete 1721 folio is shelved instead); separate printings of the Short and Easy Method with the Deists (1698-1841), the Snake in the Grass (1696-1698), the Case of the Regale (1700, 1838), Five Discourses (1700)

_excluded.leslie-other: His Jacobite political journalism (The Rehearsal) and works by other Charles Leslies
